## What is CIRCT? {#circt-name}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="38%"}
[![](assets/images/logos/circt-logo.svg){fig-alt="CIRCT logo" width="82%"}](https://circt.llvm.org/)
:::

::: {.column width="62%"}
### Circuit IR Compilers and Tools

- Apply **MLIR and LLVM compiler techniques** to hardware-design tools.
- Recursively: **CIRCT IR Compiler and Tools**.
- The `T` may be *Tool, Translator, Team, Technology, Target, Tree, Type, ...*

[The ambiguity is intentional.]{.marker}
:::
::::

**The CIRCT community is an open and welcoming community.**

[Project and community](https://circt.llvm.org/) ·
[Talks and related publications](https://circt.llvm.org/talks/) for other routes
into CIRCT, particularly from EDA.

## Can we do this with MLIR? {#circt-route}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="42%"}
**CIRCT defines the concepts from the primer:**

- **`hw`**: structure and hierarchy
- **`comb`**: combinational logic
- **`seq`**: registers and state

::: {.fragment}
- **Upstream MLIR:** `tensor`, `linalg` &rarr; `func`, `scf`, `arith`
- **Downstream:** SystemVerilog &rarr; simulation, FPGA, ASIC tools
:::

::: {.fragment}
[Next: use the CIRCT tools.]{.marker}
:::
